resolutions.note: EO 11348 (1967-04-20) revokes EO 10800, the order whose section 2 text EO 10805 amends. EO 10805's section 2 is a single self-executing amendment performed on signing, 1959-02-18, and is recorded as terminated on that date; a later revocation of the amended order cannot change that date. EO 11348 does not name EO 10805 and does not touch the Central Intelligence Agency exceptions in section 1, which stay operative.

EO 11012 (1962-03-27) revokes or supersedes other provisions of EO 10530, which EO 11228 modifies; I read its operative sentences and it does not name EO 11228 or the provisions EO 11228 changes. It is not a later event of EO 11228's own clauses, and the claim's clause states are unchanged.

EO 11196 (1965-02-02) supersedes Part III of EO 10530. It does not name EO 11228 and does not revoke or supersede any clause of EO 11228 itself; it concerns a different part of the order EO 11228 modifies, so it is not a later event for EO 11228.

EO 11230 (1965-06-28) supersedes Part I of EO 10530. It does not name EO 11228 and does not revoke or supersede any clause of EO 11228 itself; it concerns a different part of the order EO 11228 modifies, so it is not a later event for EO 11228.

EO 12363 (1982-05-21) revokes EO 11264 as amended. EO 12292's section 10(h) had already revoked Part III of EO 11264 on issuance in 1981 and is recorded as terminated on 1981-02-23. EO 12363 does not name EO 12292, and its revocation of the target order cannot revive or end any clause of EO 12292.

EO 9521 (1945-02-13) revokes EO 9452, which EO 12292's section 10(a) later revokes in turn. EO 9521 is earlier than EO 12292, does not name it and cannot be an event of its clauses; section 10(a) is recorded as terminated on 1981-02-23 whatever state EO 9452 was in.

EO 12292 (1981-02-23) revoked section 1-201(a)(14) of EO 12163. It is earlier than EO 13361 (2004-11-16), does not name EO 13361, and concerns a provision EO 13361 does not touch; EO 13361's amendments of EO 12163 are self-executing, performed on signing and recorded as terminated on 2004-11-16.

EO 13118 (1999-03-31) revoked Part 1-4 of EO 12163, which is earlier than EO 13361 (2004-11-16), does not name EO 13361, and does not concern the provisions EO 13361 adds (1-100(a)(16), 1-701(h) and (i), 1-906). Its amendments are recorded as terminated on signing, and sections 2 and 3 stay operative.
